pages.title: Tools of the Trade
pages.text: A few helpers explain the pack for you: JEI, Create Ponder, Jade, Engineer's Goggles, the Xaero maps and AppleSkin. Learn these first and you rarely need a web wiki.

**JEI**, Just Enough Items, lists every item and recipe. Hover an item and press **R** for how to make it, **U** for what it is used in. Press **A** on an item to bookmark it. Machine recipes (mixing, pressing, fan processing) appear here too.

pages.title: Engineer's Goggles
pages.text: Wear them to see stress, speed and extra info on kinetic machines, tanks and basins. See [#](2E5AAC)[Stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]().

**Create Ponder**: hover over almost any Create item (in your inventory or JEI) and hold **W**. An animated scene shows how it works. Many add-on mods use Ponder too.

Ponder is the first place to look for how a Create machine behaves, so these entries do not repeat every block.

**Jade**: point at a block or mob and a small box names it, its mod, and extra details such as machine contents or crop growth.

**AppleSkin**: food tooltips show hunger and saturation, and the hunger bar previews what a food will restore.

**Xaero's Minimap and World Map** show where you are and what you have explored. Create add-ons put train and ship info on them. Map keys are listed under Options > Controls.

Waypoints, map tips and coordinates are covered in [#](2E5AAC)[Maps](entry://home/maps)[#]().

**Changed keys.** The pack rebinds a few defaults; the rest keep their normal key. Check Options > Controls.

- Backpack open: J
- Jetpack toggle: N
- Accessories screen: comma

- Shader reload (Iris): F8
- Aether invisibility: =
- Supplementaries quiver: backtick
- Stock ticker (Mobile Packages): period
- Player networks: semicolon

- Cataclysm abilities: Home, End, Insert, Delete
- Railways Navigator overlay options: backslash

A launcher may overwrite the file holding these when the pack updates, which resets them.
